2609.08226.title: TTGBench: Benchmarking Topological Evolution and Semantic Drift in Text-attributed Temporal Graphs
2609.08226.paper_summary: Temporal graph learning models the evolution of dynamic systems, where both structural interactions and semantic states change over time. However, existing benchmarks primarily emphasize structural evolution via temporal link prediction (TLP), while support for semantic evolution remains limited. Although temporal node classification (TNC) is sometimes included, it is typically restricted to simplistic binary settings that fail to capture realistic semantic drift. Moreover, commonly used datasets exhibit high link repetition, leading to inflated performance estimates and obscuring true model capability. To address these limitations, we introduce \textbf{TTGBench}, a new benchmark that jointly evaluates structural and semantic evolution. TTGBench comprises six real-world, text-rich datasets characterized by \emph{Dual Volatility}, enabling rigorous and fair evaluation of existing models. Notably, it is the first benchmark to support both multi-class and multi-label TNC, filling a critical gap in evaluating temporal semantic drift. We conduct a comprehensive evaluation of 17 state-of-the-art methods across Temporal Graph Neural Networks (TGNNs) and Large Language Model (LLM)-based paradigms. The results reveal a clear \emph{capability divide} between the two paradigms: TGNN-based methods excel at structural prediction but fail at semantic tracking, whereas LLM-based predictors show the opposite trend. Through in-depth analysis, we uncover their fundamental limitations and provide insights for developing more comprehensive temporal graph models.
2609.08226.paper_summary_zh: 時間圖學習模型動態系統的演變，其中結構互動和語義狀態隨時間變化。然而，現有基準主要強調透過時間鏈接預測（TLP）來進行結構演變，而對語義演變的支持仍然有限。儘管有時會包含時間節點分類（TNC），但通常僅限於簡單的二元設置，無法捕捉現實的語義漂移。此外，常用的數據集顯示出高鏈接重複，導致性能估計膨脹，模糊了真實模型的能力。為了解決這些限制，我們引入了\textbf{TTGBench}，一個新的基準，聯合評估結構和語義演變。TTGBench包含六個真實世界的文本豐富數據集，特徵為\emph{雙重波動性}，使得對現有模型的評估更加嚴謹和公平。值得注意的是，它是第一個支持多類和多標籤TNC的基準，填補了評估時間語義漂移的關鍵空白。我們對17種最先進的方法進行了全面評估，涵蓋時間圖神經網絡（TGNNs）和基於大型語言模型（LLM）的範式。結果顯示出兩種範式之間明顯的\emph{能力差距}：基於TGNN的方法在結構預測方面表現優異，但在語義跟踪上失敗，而基於LLM的預測器則顯示出相反的趨勢。通過深入分析，我們揭示了它們的基本限制，並為開發更全面的時間圖模型提供了見解。
